title: Database Pool Configuration
description: Schema for database connection pool configurations

description.description: Optional description of the pool configuration

defaultPool.description: Default pool name to use when route doesn't match any pattern

description.description: Optional description of the pool's purpose

maxSize.description: Maximum number of connections in the pool

incrementSize.description: Number of connections to add when pool is exhausted

jobPriority.description: IBM i job run priority (1-99, lower=higher priority). Set per-connection on IBM i.

connectionString.description: Optional ODBC connection string. If not provided, uses ODBC_CONNECTION_STRING from environment.

libraryList.description: IBM i library list applied via CHGLIBL on idb-connector connections (ODBC uses DBQ in connection string).

currentLibrary.description: IBM i current library applied via CHGCURLIB on idb-connector connections.

validateOnBorrow.description: When true, validate a pooled connection before reuse after it has been idle longer than idleValidationMillis.

idleValidationMillis.description: Minimum idle age in milliseconds before a borrowed connection is health-checked.

maxIdleMillis.description: Maximum idle age in milliseconds before a pooled connection is closed instead of reused. Zero disables idle eviction.

connectionCreateRetries.description: Number of retry attempts when creating a connection fails with a transient communication error.

connectionCreateRetryDelayMillis.description: Delay in milliseconds between transient connection creation retry attempts.

healthCheckSql.description: SQL statement used to validate a stale borrowed connection.

sqlConcurrency.description: Maximum number of SQL statements to execute concurrently for one request.

routePatterns.description: Route patterns that should use this pool (glob patterns supported)
